dashboard.noProjectsBody: Describe what you want to build. Saqina Dev turns it into requirements, a PRD, a plan and tasks.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Saqina Dev
onboarding.question: What are you building?
onboarding.body: Answer a short interview. Your answers become a structured project with requirements, a PRD, a plan and tasks that you and your agents can work from.
onboarding.resumeBody: Your previous progress on {name} is saved.

github.title: Import an existing project
github.body: Saqina reads the README, PRD and docs in your repository and fills in the interview for you. You review the answers instead of starting from scratch.
github.tokenHint: A fine-grained token with read access to Contents. It is stored encrypted and connects the repository to the project.
github.aiHint: The repository documents are sent to your configured AI model to fill in the answers more accurately. Without it, simple rules are used and nothing leaves this server.

errors.invalid: Enter a repository as owner/name or a GitHub URL.
errors.auth_failed: GitHub refused access. Check the token and its permissions.
errors.not_found: Repository not found. For a private repository, add a token.
errors.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Could not reach GitHub. Try again.
errors.provider_error: GitHub returned an error. Try again later.
errors.too_large: A file in this repository is too large to read.
errors.unsupported: This repository host is not supported yet.
errors.github_not_connected: Connect your GitHub account again, or paste a token.

github.connectHint: Connect your GitHub account to pick a repository from your list, including private ones. No token to copy. You can disconnect at any time.

flags.denied: GitHub access was not granted. Connect again if you want to pick from your repositories.
flags.invalid_state: The connection attempt expired or did not match this browser. Try connecting again.
flags.exchange_failed: GitHub did not complete the connection. Try again.
flags.profile_failed: Connected, but GitHub did not return your account. Try again.
flags.not_configured: Connecting to GitHub is not set up on this server.
flags.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a while.

picker.label: Your repositories
picker.empty: No repositories found for this account.
picker.load_failed: Could not load your repositories. Try again.
picker.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.

newProject.title: What do you want to build?
newProject.body: Describe it in your own words. You can refine everything in the interview.
newProject.label: Your idea
newProject.placeholder: I want a POS for my small restaurant with table orders and daily sales reports.
exampleList: A POS for a small restaurant with table orders
A marketplace where local craftsmen sell to buyers
A booking system for a dental clinic
A portfolio site for an architecture studio
newProject.tooShort: Describe the idea in at least 10 characters.
newProject.importBody: You started the interview on the public preview. Import those answers into this project?

settings.title: Account
settings.name: Name
settings.sessionBody: Signing out ends this session on this device.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Allow new people to create an account. When off, only people with a valid client invitation can register. Existing accounts are not affected.

account.title: Your data
account.description: Download a copy of what Saqina holds about you, or delete your account.
account.exportBody: A JSON file with your profile, memberships, what you wrote and your activity. Keys and tokens are never included.
account.deleteBody: This removes your account, sessions, keys, notifications and projects only you belong to. What you wrote in shared projects stays, without your name. This cannot be undone.

blocked.lastPlatformOwner: You are the only platform owner. Hand the role to someone else first.
blocked.ownsSharedProjects: You own projects that other people use: {projects}. Transfer or delete them first.
blocked.ownsSharedOrganizations: You own an organization that has other members. Transfer or delete it first.

account.solo: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {1 project only you belong to is} other {# projects only you belong to are}} deleted with the account.

states.saveFailed: Not saved. Retrying when you make the next change.
states.errorBody: This page could not be loaded. Try again; if it keeps failing, share the reference with support.
states.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.

errors.CONFLICT: This changed in the meantime. Reload to see the latest version.
